scope: All 39 properties, all 14 known open targets, and crate-specific future work remain in scope. Inventory and documentation alone do not prove implementation.

status_meanings.unverified: The requirement has not been audited to its full scope.
status_meanings.open: Implementation or evidence is still required.
status_meanings.in-progress: Concrete work exists, but the complete requirement is not yet proved.
status_meanings.verified: Current implementation and linked evidence prove the complete requirement.

properties.requirement: Exactness by construction. Exact rational values stay exact until an API *explicitly* requests approximation or float conversion. No hidden binary64 demotion anywhere in the core. *Criterion:* no code path demotes a scalar except at named boundary APIs.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property. Native circle_polygon geometry, exact-decimal KiCad via copper, and authoritative profile-bound composition are repaired. Native DRC boundary metrics and their required comparisons now use authoritative regularized boundaries and retain uncertainty through readiness receipts (1,142 configured tests, strict Clippy/docs/formatting and candidate cost evidence). DRC component/report caches now retain successful native results under STRICT/source/budget guards; required projection failures reach uncertainty receipts, migrated candidate indices retain unknown bounds, and required net width reads native bounds. Six consumer snapshots were audited across 190 changed IDs and 202 feature pairs. Guarded DRC Boolean/offset/classification/bounds operations and native circle callers now retain source/policy/budget failures; offset bounds come from the resulting set, and migrated envelope-dimension consumers retain uncertainty. Other finite heuristics, source shapes, non-distance Option/filter_map consumers and the property-wide audit remain open. PCB native handoff, area and emptiness queries now reject retained source failures and exhausted scopes; implicit Deref access is removed, explicit replacement invalidates old facts/caches, and profile aggregation preserves supported higher-order native carriers. Required net-length measurement failures prevent partial net/pair totals. Handoff/aggregation regressions and final validation/cost evidence are recorded in docs/evidence/2026-10-08-hyperdrc-handoff/manifest.json. Required Polygon area and report-area filtering now retain unavailable integrals, unknown comparisons, non-finite report output and shared-budget failures as uncertainty. Whole-layer totals and qualifying paste/mask coverage use native regularized unions; duplicate apertures do not create windowpanes or double coverage. KiCad retains failed pad geometry for diagnostics. Area regressions, preserved ancestor/staged failures and validation/cost evidence are recorded in docs/evidence/2026-10-08-hyperdrc-area/manifest.json. Required bounds and other optional numeric consumers, report-chord width shortcuts, bounding-box density proxies, finite source adapters and remaining native source families still require audit.

properties.requirement: Structure preservation. Recognizable symbolic forms — π, e, roots, logs, trig endpoints, removable small-angle limits, quadratic surds `a + b√d` — stay symbolic while that avoids precision loss or repeated approximation. *Criterion:* an identity provable from the certificate must not require refinement; `hypot` of 3-4-5 stays exact.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Conservative, honest facts. Structural facts are cheap-or-Unknown: "Unknown" means "not cheaply proven," never "false." Equality is structural, not theorem-proving, and says so. *Criterion:* no fact API returns a definite answer without a certificate behind it.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Monotone refinement caches. Cached approximations and facts must never weaken a later higher-precision request. Cache hits must not change semantics, structural facts, or later answers. *Criterion:* any query answered identically with and without a warm cache, at all precisions.

properties.requirement: Bounded explosion. Growth is prevented at the earliest layer with enough information: dyadic recognition, shared-denominator reducers, product-sum shapes, perfect-root collapsing. `Computable` is the fallback, never the default container. *Criterion:* repeated operand chains do not force GCD work per term or build avoidable expression trees.

properties.requirement: Certainty receipts. Results carry `Certified` vs. `Approximate512Consumed` — the *cost class of the proof* is a return value. *Criterion:* a consumer can always distinguish exact from fallback-decided without inspecting internals.

properties.requirement: Least-cost proof search. The decision cascade (structural shortcut → rational reducer → bounded refinement → deterministic terminal) finds the cheapest sufficient certificate, JIT-like for repeated queries. *Criterion:* repeated queries amortize; prepared objects beat one-shot paths on measured benches.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Representational closure: every exact result needed by the next operation remains representable.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Evidentiary closure: roots, selected fibers, parameters, signs, and topology decisions retain enough identity and proof information to be reused or replayed.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Computational closure: the output may be mathematically valid, but repeated operations must not cause uncontrolled expression depth, coefficient growth, redundant refinement, allocation traffic, or reconstruction cost
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: One exact arrangement. Booleans validate closed PWN input, corefine shared faces, build one radial cell complex, propagate absolute windings, and select closure-certified boundaries — one `boolean()` entry point, shared intersections across expression roots. *Criterion:* additional expression roots do not repeat arrangement work.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Broad input contract, typed rejections. Disconnected, nested, coincident, balanced-nonmanifold, and winding-multiplicity inputs are supported; open meshes, invalid indices, and degenerate triangles are typed failures — never hangs, never wrong output, never unbounded allocation. *Criterion:* adversarial Boolean matrix (tangent, coplanar, near-coplanar, sliver, inverted, duplicate, invalid) all decide or diagnose.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Unbounded sets never masquerade as finite. Negation/exterior-containing expressions return `UnboundedBooleanOutput` rather than a finite mesh that misrepresents the result. *Criterion:* no finite output is ever emitted for an exterior-inside result.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Tolerance-free coincidence. Near-coincident-but-distinct geometry stays distinct; there is no epsilon merge anywhere. *Criterion:* a point at 1e-12 outside a cube is outside; a 1e-12 translation is preserved in bounds.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Vocabulary, not a second kernel. CSGRS composes native Hyper types — it never introduces another mesh, region, or polygon carrier. *Criterion:* every public type is a re-export or adapter of a kernel type.
properties.remaining: Audit production behavior and gather evidence at the full scope of this property.

properties.requirement: Intent-preserving interchange. IO and scalar adapters are lossy only at their documented boundaries; floats appear only at explicit rendering, serialization, adapter, FFI, and wasm edges. *Criterion:* round-trips through every supported format preserve exact geometry where the format allows.
